title: Senior Advisor, Vaccine & Clinical Case Management
description:
Job Title: Senior Advisor, Vaccine & Clinical Case Management
Location: Remote, East Coast Preferred
Description
Founded in 2004, BME Strategies is a Massachusetts-based consulting firm specializing in the design, implementation, and evaluation of public health programs for local, regional, and state government partners. Our work supports evidence-based, community-driven solutions that strengthen public health systems and advance equity across the communities we serve. At BME, our clients are on the front lines of Public Health. Priorities may shift but our commitment to supporting our partners does not. We take pride in having multi-year, multi-project engagements, often working closely as an extension of their staff. Our success comes from our shared values: a bias toward action; optimistically collaborative; willingness to navigate ambiguity; minimal ego - no job is too small or big; pursuing the equitable solution; always learning, and; committed to quality at every stage.
Position Overview
The Senior Advisor, Vaccine & Clinical Case Management will act as a product owner and lead the vision, backlog, and delivery of a new vaccine management and clinical case management system for Massachusetts local health departments. The role sits between local public health practitioners, the Massachusetts Department of Public Health (DPH) Office of Local and Regional Health, and the IT delivery team. The system will support immunization clinics, vaccine inventory and accountability, public health nursing case management, and insurance billing for clinical services. It must align with related DPH platforms' data model, user experience and governance so local health departments experience one coherent set of tools. The ideal candidate has worked inside a local health department and knows firsthand how public health nurses, clinic coordinators, and health directors do their work.
Project Overview
The Massachusetts Department of Public Health (DPH), Office of Local and Regional Health, is building a statewide vaccine management and clinical case management system for the Commonwealth's 351 local health departments. The goal is to develop one modern, secure system that supports clinical public health work from start to finish.
The system will help local health departments:

• Run immunization programs by planning clinics, scheduling patients, documenting vaccine administration and reporting to the Massachusetts Immunization Information System (MIIS).

• Manage vaccine supply through inventory, ordering, lot tracking, cold chain monitoring and accountability for state-supplied vaccines.

• Coordinate nursing case management for tuberculosis, communicable disease follow-up and home visiting, including intake, care plans, visits, referrals and case closure.

• Bill for clinical services by verifying insurance, generating claims and tracking reimbursement from MassHealth, Medicare and commercial payers.

• Report and use data with dashboards and reports for local, regional and state users.

The system is being designed with local public health, not just for it. Public health nurses, clinic staff, and health directors will shape requirements, test features, and guide rollout. The result should reduce administrative burden, strengthen data quality and help departments sustain clinical services across communities of every size with a particular focus on ensuring any solution is effectively implemented in rural communities.

title: Strategic Fixer
description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

OVERVIEW

Our largest customers run complex operations, and when something isn’t working, the problem rarely sits neatly within one team. A customer may be implementing a new product, dealing with a complicated integration, or facing an operational issue with no obvious owner or solution. That’s where you come in!

We’re looking for a Strategic Fixer who wants exposure to a wide range of problems and is ready to own outcomes. You will take ambiguous problems, structure them, dig into the details, align senior stakeholders, and drive execution across teams that don’t report to you.

This isn’t a role where you make a recommendation and hand it off. One week you might be diagnosing a failing payroll integration, the next coordinating an engineering fix, and the next working with a customer’s VP of Operations to get an implementation back on track. The problems might vary, but your job stays the same: figure it out, get the right people moving, and own the problem until it’s solved. This role opens doors to a range of growth paths across Clipboard!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Analyze operational data to spot trends and bottlenecks, and turn your findings into clear recommendations that guide business decisions.

- Research and evaluate new tools, including AI, automation, and internal systems, and drive their adoption to make operations more effective.

- Design processes, workflows, and operating procedures that improve efficiency, quality, and customer experience

- Lead cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives from planning through execution, partnering with Operations, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and other teams.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 2-6 years of experience in a problem-solving role, such as strategy or management consulting, operations, strategy & operations, implementation, customer strategy, or program management.

- Experience solving operational problems by improving processes, designing workflows, or building scalable systems, while juggling multiple priorities in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

- Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data (e.g., SQL, Python) to diagnose problems and support decisions.

- Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex problems simply and align stakeholders across teams, from frontline operators to senior leaders.

- A high level of ownership. You don’t stop at the recommendation; you stay with the problem until it’s solved.

- A deep curiosity that drives you to reason from first principles and dig until you find the root cause.

- A habit of going to the source: testing the feature, listening to the agent call, calling the customer, or running the workflow.

WHY JOIN CLIPBOARD?

- We are remote-first, giving you the flexibility to work with us from many places.

- Fast-paced startup environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

- A hiring process that rewards skills, not just experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot, our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

- Opportunity to make a significant impact with our customers on both sides of the marketplace.

The ideal candidate understands how to move beyond traditional, step-by-step automation to build adaptive AI systems that can reason through tasks, select and use tools, maintain relevant context, and execute workflows with minimal human intervention. Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

The Senior Customer Success Engineer (Senior CSE) is an advanced technical role within the Customer Success organization, serving as a subject matter expert and escalation point for complex, high-impact technical challenges. Building on the foundation of the CSE role, the Senior CSE handles the most technically demanding and strategically significant issues, provides mentorship to CSE peers, and drives the development of scalable processes, tooling, and knowledge assets that elevate the entire team’s capabilities. Website | X/Twitter | LinkedIn

Transfer Agency and Issuer Services are two critical functions on the Securitize Platform: one keeps investor records accurate through every subscription, redemption, and reconciliation; the other provides the tools needed to bring new assets onto the platform and manages them through their full lifecycle. As a Product Manager spanning both core areas you will work with senior PMs to refine what Operations, Compliance, and institutional clients need into requirements Engineering can successfully build from.
What You'll Do

Nice to Have

What We Offer

title: Manager, Lease Accounting
description:
About the Team
The DoorDash Lease Accounting team ensures DoorDash’s lease portfolio is reported accurately and on time under ASC 842. This requires deep technical accounting review and careful interpretation of complex, often ambiguous lease arrangements. As the portfolio grows in size and complexity, we continue to strengthen our processes to keep pace with the business.
About the Role
You will report to the Senior Accounting Manager on our Lease Accounting team. As the Lease Accounting Manager, you will be a key technical expert on ASC 842, ensuring DoorDash’s leases are accounted for accurately as the business grows. This role is built for someone who takes ownership, stays ahead of the work, and works closely with partners across functions. Success means well-supported conclusions and dependable reporting each period, with the opportunity to apply your expertise to increasingly complex leases.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Review lease abstractions against new lease agreements and lease modifications to ensure accurate classification and recognition of each lease in accordance with ASC 842.

• Perform detailed accounting analysis of complex lease arrangements and unique scenarios that go beyond standard treatment, documenting conclusions and supporting analysis.

• Perform lease monthly close activities including journal entries, account reconciliations, and flux analysis

• Own lease financial reporting deliverables, including cash flows, rollforwards, and disclosures.

• Partner closely with Real Estate, Lease Administration and other cross-functional teams to understand lease activity early and keep the accounting accurate and timely.

• Proactively identify and lead process improvements and automation initiatives to reduce manual work and improve the accuracy and efficiency of processes.

• Maintain lease SOX controls and support both internal and external audit requests.

We’re excited about you because…

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, or a related field, and/or equivalent work experience.

• 6+ years accounting experience, including in-depth experience applying US GAAP lease accounting (ASC 842), which is essential to this role.

• Proven experience reviewing lease agreements, interpreting lease terms, and assessing their financial implications to determine the appropriate accounting treatment.

• Ownership mindset and proactiveness, with a track record of managing multiple deliverables and following them through to completion on close timelines.

• Strong cross-functional partnership and communication skills to work effectively with internal and external partners.

• Close attention to detail and demonstrated problem-solving skills.

We expect this position to be filled by 01/03/2027

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). title: Amazon Operations Specialist

title: Coding Manager, Coding PB
description:
Coding Manager, Professional Fee Medical Coding
The Coding Manager oversees the provider-based medical coding team ensuring all professional services are coded with the highest level of accuracy, compliance and efficiency while supporting HURC clients.
This role serves as a subject matter expert and client-facing leader responsible for evaluating professional fee medical coding and related revenue cycle operations, identifying performance opportunities, developing recommendations, and leading implementation initiatives that improve coding accuracy, billing performance, reimbursement, compliance, quality, and financial outcomes.
This position requires a strong understanding of provider-based coding methodologies, revenue cycle operations, payer requirements, reimbursement, analytics, and operational performance.
Key Responsibilities

• Supervises day-to-day coding operations for professional fee claims across multiple clinical specialties.

•

Monitor workflow and ensure compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs).

• Steps in for hands-on support on complex coding reviews and escalated coding issues from the customer and coders.

• Monitor program performance and develop corrective action and improvement plans.

• Identify opportunities to improve coding accuracy, reimbursement, productivity, quality, and financial performance.

• Provide subject matter expertise in professional fee coding and billing.

• Evaluate coding and billing workflows and identify operational gaps.

• Review coding accuracy, productivity, quality, reimbursement, and compliance trends.

• Evaluate the relationship between documentation, coding, billing, reimbursement, and denials.

• Identify opportunities to reduce coding-related denials and prevent revenue leakage.

• Evaluate charge capture, claim submission, edits, billing workflows, and payer requirements.

• Partner with CDI, coding, utilization review, denials, and revenue cycle teams to improve overall financial performance.

• Maintain knowledge of ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, modifiers, edits, medical necessity, and applicable payer requirements.

Client Leadership

• Serves as a client-facing leader for professional fee coding operations.

• Lead coder and client meetings.

• Develop recommendations based on client data, workflows, financial performance, and operational findings.

• Establish strong relationships with coding leaders, providers and other stakeholders.

• Manage client escalations and ensure timely resolution.

• Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships through additional solutions.

title: QA Engineer — Web & Mobile
description:
QA Engineer, Web and Mobile
Individual contributor. Reports to the Director of QA. No direct reports.
Salary : €5000 per month
Location : Poland (Fully Remote)
The role
You test the web application, frontend and backend, and the mobile applications on iOS and Android. That is the surface of the job.
Underneath it, the point of this role is to understand how the product actually works: the data flow, the API contracts, the places where two systems meet and produce behaviour nobody specified. That understanding is what lets you improve a specification before code is written, catch the gap nobody else noticed, and give Support, Sales, Product and Engineering an answer they can rely on.
We are looking for extreme ownership, the person who picks up the task nobody else wants because it needs doing and they can see why it matters.
What you will do
Test the product properly. Web end to end, frontend behaviour and backend responses, not just the UI layer. Mobile on iOS and Android against an agreed device and OS matrix, with a real understanding of platform conventions and where the two diverge.
Own our automated coverage on web. Extend and maintain the Playwright suite and write new tests for the features you take through. Investigate failures and fix flakiness rather than muting it, and be honest about what automation is and is not covering.
Verify at the API and data layer. Requests, responses, payloads, status codes, backward compatibility for older clients. Query the database directly to confirm what actually happened, rather than what the screen says happened.
Prevent bugs, not just report them. Pressure-test specifications with Product, Design and engineers before development starts: happy paths, edge cases, error states, empty states. Point out the platform that was forgotten, the API version that will break, the migration nobody planned. Asking the awkward question early is part of the job.
Debug to root cause. "It doesn't work" is not a bug report. Narrow down where it breaks and what the system is actually doing, and hand the developer something they can act on.
Support the wider business. Reproduce and triage customer issues that reach engineering, and keep test plans and known-issue lists current so release decisions rest on evidence.
Use AI every day. Reduce your own repetitive work with it, build reusable AI skills the wider team can benefit from, make small fixes in the code yourself where that is reasonable, and bring ideas about where AI can raise our quality bar.
What we are looking for

• Three to five years of hands-on testing of web applications, with a demonstrated ability to find root causes rather than symptoms.

• Practical test automation experience. You have written and maintained UI or API tests in Playwright, or a comparable framework, and can work in a test codebase without hand-holding.

• You can read and reason about API contracts and payloads, query a database in SQL to verify data, and are comfortable with traffic and API inspection tooling, or quick to pick it up.

• Mobile testing in practice. You can tell a platform convention apart from a defect, and reason about the device and OS coverage a given change actually needs.

• Proven collaboration with Design and Product. You have been in the room during specification work and made it better without owning it, with examples you can talk us through.

• Excellent written and spoken communication, in Polish and English, both at C2 or native level.

Nice to have

• Testing in a regulated or healthcare-adjacent domain.

• Device farms or cloud device labs, such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.

• Triaging from crash and error monitoring, such as Sentry or Crashlytics.

• Accessibility testing (WCAG).

title: Power BI Adoption Lead - Remote - EU/EEA
description:
This is a remote position.
Power BI Adoption Lead
Most Power BI roles ask you to build what someone else has already specified. This one asks you to decide how an entire enterprise uses Power BI - and then to make it happen. A leading UK financial services organisation is standing up a modern cloud data platform, with Power BI as the strategic reporting layer on top of it. The governed semantic layer, certified datasets, enterprise design standards and community of practice are still being shaped - and the organisation is serious enough about data capability to have already invested in it. You will decide what good looks like, and own it end to end.

This is deliberately not a pure Power BI developer role, and equally not a change-management role. It is the rarer combination: someone who can build a performant enterprise semantic model, credibly challenge a developer's DAX, then stand in front of the business and teach it.

What you'll do

• Own the enterprise Power BI adoption roadmap, with measurable adoption and value targets.

• Build engagement from the ground up: stakeholder buy-in, a champions network, forums, clinics and a genuine community of practice.

• Design and personally deliver structured training - workshops, learning materials and guidance, pitched from Excel-refugee to seasoned analyst.

• Shape the governed semantic layer alongside data engineering: consistent KPI definitions, certification processes, naming conventions and refresh strategy.

• Author the enterprise reporting Design Guide - standards, templates, palettes, UX conventions - and hold the organisation to it.

• Establish workspace governance: deployment pipelines, Dev/QA/Prod design, RLS/CLS, sensitivity labelling and auditability.

• Build and optimise flagship dashboards yourself, and troubleshoot performance where others are stuck.

• Reduce duplicated, ungoverned reporting - and prove you have.

Requirements

Essential experience

• Power BI technical depth - you have personally delivered enterprise-scale Power BI. Advanced DAX, Power Query/M, semantic model design and optimisation, large and complex datasets, workspace strategy and administration, RLS, certified datasets. You can coach on all of it and push back on poor implementation.

• Adoption & change leadership - you have created an enterprise adoption roadmap, run champion networks, driven cultural change around data-driven decision making, and measured adoption and business value. This is the most critical dimension of the role.

• Training & enablement - you have designed and personally delivered structured training programmes and built the materials yourself. Occasional knowledge-sharing is not what we mean.

• Governance & operating model - reporting standards, dashboard design principles, workspace management, certified dataset processes and self-service controls. You know how to scale Power BI without creating a governance problem.

Desirable

• Microsoft Fabric - architecture, capacity and medallion/lakehouse patter

• Power Apps, ideally integrated with Power BI.

• Sensitive, confidential or regulated data; Azure exposure; PL-300 and/or

Interview process

Shortlisted candidates will prepare a maximum of two PowerPoint slides on their approach to enterprise Power BI adoption, and demo a Power BI dashboard they personally designed and built on a dataset of their choice - covering the business problem, auorytelling, accessibility and how they would drive ongoing usage. Format and style are entirely your own.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

title: Business Development Manager - AI Factory
description:
Job Summary:
The Business Development Manager (BDM) for AI Infrastructure plays a key role in driving client engagement and opportunity development for CDW full-stack AI Factory solutions. This role is responsible for identifying, qualifying, and shaping new business aligned to AI Factory workloads. The ideal candidate brings strong commercial acumen, technical fluency, and a passion for helping clients
accelerate their AI transformation.

What you will do:

• Drive new opportunity generation and pipeline growth by engaging directly with clients and account teams to uncover AI infrastructure needs through target account identification and pursuit.

• Clearly understand the business impacts of AI infrastructure use cases in the sales segments they cover and be able to communicate CDW ’s value proposition around those solutions.

• Position and articulate the value of full-stack AI infrastructure, including high-performance compute (CPU/GPU), storage and data, orchestration (Kubernetes, Slurm, etc.), MLOps, and integration with AI/ML tools and frameworks.

• Lead strategic sales motions from initial discovery through presales collaboration and proposal development, ensuring alignment with both business outcomes and technical requirements.

• Collaborate with CDW Practice Leads and Architects to develop client-ready architectures and solution overviews.

• Act as a key point of contact for Sales, helping them identify and qualify AI Factory opportunities within their existing accounts.

• Engage with strategic partners (e.g., NVIDIA, NetApp, Cisco, Dell, etc.) to jointly develop and promote aligned offerings.

• Maintain a deep understanding of the AI/ML landscape, client buying behaviors, and competitive positioning to continuously refine the GTM approach.

• Contribute to marketing events, webinars, workshops, and executive briefings to build awareness and generate interest.

• Provide structured feedback to the AI Factory leadership team on market trends, client priorities, and portfolio development needs.

• Responsibility to establish deep sales team relationships to drive opportunity creation in addition to hunting for net-new customers that may not have existing Sales alignment.

What we expect of you:

• 8 years of experience in business development, sales, or solution selling in enterprise technology space, with a focus on infrastructure, cloud, or AI/ML.

• Strong understanding of enterprise AI/ML workloads and the supporting infrastructure stack (compute, storage, networking, orchestration, MLOps).

• Proven ability to lead complex, consultative sales cycles and work cross-functionally with technical and delivery teams.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with both technical and executive stakeholders.

• Self-starter with a growth mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-evolving, emerging practice area.

Pay range: $113,525 - $158,925 depending on experience and skill set.
Annual bonus target of 40% subject to terms and conditions of plan
Benefits overview:
Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials.

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization
We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances-not replaces-human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work. Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways
